# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository is public. Never introduce secrets, PII, customer information, proprietary customer code, confidential Adobe information, or private communications.

Read `AI.md` and `AGENTS.md` before making substantial changes.

Use trunk-based development. Prefer small, reviewable changes. Use conventional commit messages.

When requirements are ambiguous, ask rather than guessing.

For code changes:
- inspect existing architecture first
- preserve established conventions
- avoid unnecessary dependencies
- add or update tests when behavior changes
- update documentation when behavior changes
- explain non-obvious implementation decisions
